operation.description:
Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Returns a paginated list of packages (membership and credit-charge packages) for the account.

### Ordering
Newest first — `id` descending — unless you pass a `sort` parameter.

### Branch scoping
When the Branches add-on is enabled, results are automatically limited to your current branch. To widen the scope:

| Goal | How |
|---|---|
| A specific branch | `request_branch_id=<branch id>` |
| Every branch you have access to | `filter[branch_id][equal]=-1` |

Packages stored without a branch are not returned while branch scoping is in effect.

### Deleted packages
Deleted packages are excluded, so `deleted_at` is always `null` in this response. Fetch a deleted package directly by its id if you need it.

### Filtering
Use `filter[<field>][<operator>]=<value>`. Omitting the operator means `equal` — `filter[status]=1` is the same as `filter[status][equal]=1`.

| Operator | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `equal` | equals (default) |
| `not_equal` | not equal |
| `in` / `not_in` | in / not in a list of values |
| `like` | partial text match |
| `gt` / `gte` / `from` | greater than / greater than or equal |
| `lt` / `lte` / `to` | less than / less than or equal |
| `is_null` / `is_not_null` | value is / is not empty |

Fields intended for filtering: `name`, `price`, `period_value`, `status`, `product_id`. Filtering on an unrecognised field returns `400`.

### Sorting
Use `sort[<field>]=asc` or `sort[<field>]=desc`, e.g. `sort[name]=asc`.

### Notes
- The trailing `1` in the path is an optional data-detail level. It has no effect for packages, which are always returned as flat records.
- A `fields[]` parameter is not supported; the complete record is always returned.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Records per page. Defaults to `20` when omitted.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to return. Defaults to `1`.

parameters.name: filter[status][equal]
parameters.description: Example filter. Any `filter[<field>][<operator>]` combination described above is accepted.

parameters.name: sort[name]
parameters.description: Example sort. Any `sort[<field>]=asc|desc` combination is accepted.

parameters.name: request_branch_id
parameters.description: Run the request against a specific branch instead of your current one.

period_value.description: How many `period_unit` intervals the package covers, e.g. `3` with `monthly` means three months.

period_unit.description:
The unit the validity period is counted in.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `daily` | Days |
| `weekly` | Weeks |
| `monthly` | Months |
| `yearly` | Years |
| `not-expired` | Never expires |

status.description:
Whether the package can be sold.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Inactive |
| 1 | Active |

product_id.description: Id of the product this package is linked to, or `null` when it is not linked to one.

deleted_at.description: Always `null` here — deleted packages are excluded from the list.

type.description:
What the package sells.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `credit_charge` | A bundle of credits |
| `membership` | A membership subscription |

branch_id.description: Branch the package belongs to, or `null` when it is not assigned to one.

from.description: Index of the first record on this page, or `null` when the page is empty.

links.description: Ready-made pagination links: a previous entry, one entry per page number, then a next entry.

url.description: Target URL, or `null` when there is no such page.

label.description: Display label — a page number, or a previous/next label.

page.description: Page number the entry points at, or `null`. Omitted on gap (`...`) entries.

next_page_url.description: URL of the next page, or `null` on the last page.

per_page.description: Records per page that was applied.

prev_page_url.description: URL of the previous page, or `null` on the first page.

to.description: Index of the last record on this page, or `null` when the page is empty.

400.description: The listing could not be produced.

error.description: Why the listing could not be produced — for example the Points & Credits add-on is not active for the account, or a filter referenced an unknown field.

401.description: Authentication failed, or the caller may not view packages.

message.description: Returned when the access token is missing, expired or invalid.

error.description: Returned instead of `message` when the account is authenticated but not permitted to view packages.
